# Add Translations

Use [i18n](../../.agents/skills/i18n/SKILL.md) and the [scoped locale instructions](../instructions/i18n.instructions.md).
Read the requested copy and affected message consumers.
Keep the task within locale messages and necessary consumer updates; do not create unrelated routes or pages.
Use [content direction](../../.agents/docs/content-direction.md) for wine names, factual meaning and natural English.
Check key/placeholder parity, message syntax and affected translated state, then report checks actually performed.
